name: fjs-megamenu
summary: Dark 'mega menu': a top bar (level 1) + drop panel with a categories column (level 2) and action cards (level 3). Backend-driven 1-3 level tree, full-menu search, keyboard nav, and a cookie-backed Recent group.

title.desc: Hero title above the bar (empty = no hero).

brandicon.desc: Brand mark: emoji/letter, an image (URL, a path with /, or a file name with an image extension such as logo.png; relative to this folder), or 'none'. Unset = the built-in Four Js '4' badge.

select.desc: Lowercase ON ACTION name fired when a leaf action is chosen.

recentscookie.desc: Cookie name storing recent leaf ids.

theme.desc: 'auto' follows the GBC host theme (light/dark); or force 'dark'/'light'.

accent.desc: Accent color override (e.g. #16b1a5); empty = taken from the GBC theme.

overlay.desc: 'auto' floats the drop panel over the host content (bar-only footprint) when embedded same-origin; 'off' keeps the in-flow layout.
